item.title: Macro Photography: A Beginner's Guide to Gear, Focus Stacking, and Techniques
item.description: Macro Photography: A Beginner’s Guide to Gear, Focus Stacking, and Techniques Macro photography is the art of capturing the tiny, often-overlooked details of the world around us. From the intricate textures of a dragonfly’s wing to the fine details of everyday objects, macro photography allows you to see the world up close like never before. In this guide, we’ll cover macro photography basics, essential gear recommendations, lighting setups, focus stacking software, and popular genres.
